diagnosis: The previous close_gripper on the right returned grasp_not_confirmed: the jaws closed but no sustained two-finger hold formed (held_by empty, touching both false, bottle upright at its original position). No lift occurred, so no hold needs releasing and the pick was never completed. The historical failure is not a stop condition by itself; current state shows empty hands and no contact. Recovery: verify the hands are empty, re-approach the current grasp, retry close once with verify_hold confirmation. If it fails again, open the empty right jaw, exclude the failed grasp id on the same pose revision and try the next candidate, up to two attempts. Only after a confirmed right hold does it lift, run the placement-aware transfer to the left hand, and place into the basket, then check hands are empty.
